purpose: Research-only handoff for nums 892, 894-899, and 901-913 in data-extra.js. Built from live Common Sense Media refetches of catalog srcUrl pages. Do not treat as production data until reviewed and transformed through the official workflow.

contentFlagModel.mappingNote: This refetch preserves CSM's current visible category label and proposes the nearest app level. Production catalog edits should be made only by the follow-up importer/reviewer.

entries.title: The Water Horse: Legend of the Deep

violence.summary: Military attacks on the creature, rifle fire, snapping-jaw threats, an off-screen dog death, and one adult fistfight create moderate fantasy peril.

language.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful language concern.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful sex, romance, or nudity concern.

drinking.summary: Adults drink and smoke socially in banquet and pub settings.

handoffNotes: The child's uncertainty about his father being dead may need gentle prose context.

violence.summary: Comic wrestling violence includes body slams, leaps, holds, crotch hits, pratfalls, a street fight, risky stunt gags, and an eye injury without blood.

language.summary: Mild profanity and insult humor include crude wording, an implied lyric rhyme, and accent-based jokes.

romance.summary: A mild innuendo-laced invitation reflects Ignacio's crush on Sister Encarnacion.

drinking.summary: Wine appears briefly at a party.

violence.summary: Stylized digital combat includes characters dematerializing, bloodless vehicle collisions, and one eerie energy-draining sequence.

language.summary: Only a few mild expletives are noted.

romance.summary: Brief dialogue alludes to earlier sexual relationships involving the heroine.

drinking.summary: CSM notes no actual substance use, apart from Flynn's arcade having a bar-like look.

entries.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

violence.summary: High adventure violence includes fights, gunfire, whips, chases, explosions, near-drowning, skeletons, swarming rats, gruesome villain deaths, and a disturbing rapid-aging death.

language.summary: Mild profanity and religious exclamations are used.

romance.summary: Adult flirting leads to implied sex, forced kisses are treated lightly, and father-son banter references both men sleeping with the same woman.

drinking.summary: Adults smoke and occasionally drink champagne or cocktails.

handoffNotes: Rapid-aging death, rats, snakes, and nonconsensual kissing may need prose context.

entries.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

violence.summary: Very intense violence includes human sacrifice, torture, a heart removed from a victim, child forced labor, gunfights, whipping, knife threats, bugs, and gross-out food imagery.

language.summary: Profanity includes moderate swearing and religious exclamations.

romance.summary: Sexual banter, kissing, cleavage, suggestive outfits, bedroom innuendo, and an unwanted reach into a woman's dress are noted.

drinking.summary: A nightclub setting includes visible bottles and champagne.

handoffNotes: Human sacrifice, child exploitation, and nonconsensual sexualized contact need explicit prose treatment.

entries.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull

violence.summary: Adventure violence includes gunfire, brawls, sword threats from moving vehicles, deaths by falls and fire, killer ants, nuclear-test imagery, skulls, mummies, and other scares.

language.summary: Several moderate profanities are noted, including partial stronger words and insults.

romance.summary: There is mild sexual banter, but CSM does not flag explicit sexual content.

drinking.summary: One character is briefly implied to be drunk.

handoffNotes: Nuclear-test imagery and killer-ant deaths may need prose context.

entries.title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny

violence.summary: Frequent peril includes guns, execution-style killings, bloody wounds, vehicle and plane crashes, falls, knives, captivity, near-hanging, drowning danger, explosions, eels, insects, skeletons, and wartime battle violence.

language.summary: Occasional mild and moderate language includes insults, religious exclamations, and scattered profanity.

romance.summary: Brief shirtless and underwear moments, a mild appreciative remark, and a tender kiss are noted.

drinking.summary: Adults drink fairly often across several settings, with whiskey, Scotch, a flask, cigarette smoking, a cigar stub, a pipe, and ashtrays shown.

handoffNotes: Abrupt murders, grief over family loss, and older-Indy melancholy may need prose context.

entries.title: Labyrinth

violence.summary: Fantasy peril includes roughhousing, sword fights, threatening machines, a machine gun gag, detachable-body scares, sibling separation, and threats involving a toddler.

language.summary: Mild profanity and religious exclamations are used.

romance.summary: CSM's category label does not identify sexual content, though its violence details describe Jareth's controlling obsession with teen Sarah.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: Adult-coded pursuit/control of a teenage girl appears in CSM's detail text outside the romance category and may need prose context.

entries.title: Ghostbusters

violence.summary: Paranormal action includes laser blasts, building destruction, explosions, frightening ghosts, possession by monstrous creatures, falling debris, religious-sacrifice references, and a giant creature threatening crowds.

language.summary: Moderate profanity, insults, ableist language, and sexualized jokes appear several times.

romance.summary: Sexual material includes ghost-related innuendo, possession-driven advances made without consent, revealing movement, crude dialogue, kisses, and harassment that is played lightly.

drinking.summary: Frequent smoking, adults drinking hard liquor and beer, and a comic wine-drinking ghost are noted.

handoffNotes: Possession-linked sexual advances, nonconsensual touching while unconscious, and uncriticized harassment need prose context.

entries.title: Ghostbusters II

violence.summary: Scary supernatural imagery includes severed heads, slime and ghost attacks, a baby carriage in traffic, a baby on a high ledge, kidnapping by a ghost, reckless driving, and explosions.

language.summary: Infrequent but moderate profanity appears, along with crude sexual references.

romance.summary: Sexual innuendo includes medical-exam jokes, exposure jokes, and a brief implied-sex gag.

drinking.summary: Characters mention beer, drink wine at dinner, and one character smokes a cigar.

handoffNotes: Baby-in-peril scenes and severed-head imagery may need prose context.

violence.summary: The main concern is serious karate fighting, beatings, and revenge-driven aggression.

language.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful language concern.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful sex, romance, or nudity concern.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

entries.title: The Karate Kid Part III

violence.summary: Karate fights include cheating, intentional harm, vandalism, bloody fists, and a mountain-climbing threat.

language.summary: Mild profanity appears throughout, and CSM notes two anti-Asian slurs.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful sex, romance, or nudity concern.

drinking.summary: A villain is shown with a cigar and champagne.

handoffNotes: The racial slurs should be preserved in prose sensitivity review even though the language level is low.

entries.title: Gremlins

violence.summary: Dark comic horror includes lethal blender, syringe, knife, gun, explosion, decapitation, and fire attacks, jump scares, gooey creature births, a woman killed through a window, wrecked homes, crashes, and a dog-harm threat.

language.summary: Language includes profanity, religious exclamations, a dog-harm threat, and a reference to wrist-cutting during holiday depression.

romance.summary: A creature briefly flashes a waitress, and human characters kiss passionately.

drinking.summary: Creatures drink and smoke heavily, a human character is associated with drunkenness, and police joke about being intoxicated at work.

handoffNotes: Holiday-depression and wrist-cutting reference needs prose context; horror-comedy violence is much harsher than the family premise may suggest.

entries.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch

violence.summary: Mostly cartoonish but frequent mayhem includes a head shooting and a paper-shredder death with green goo.

language.summary: CSM notes one mild profanity.

romance.summary: Sexualized jokes include unwanted under-table touching and a pornography reference.

drinking.summary: Smoking and drinking appear in several scenes, including cigarettes, a pipe, beer, cocktails, sherry, and bar-set creature partying.

handoffNotes: The page rates drinking as a little despite multiple drinking and smoking examples; reviewer may want to check whether app level 2 is sufficient.

violence.summary: Comic peril includes vandalism, a stair fall during a tooth-removal gag, rough reindeer flying, snowballs thrown at a house, and other slapstick.

language.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful language concern.

romance.summary: A brief rear-end joke appears when the robotic Santa is created.

drinking.summary: A cocoa gag has robotic Santa acting as if buzzed after drinking.

entries.title: The Santa Clause 3: The Escape Clause

violence.summary: Slapstick includes a shovel hit, pants catching fire, a character knocked down, and Santa falling from a roof and disappearing from his clothes.

language.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful language concern.

romance.summary: CSM's detail text mentions Mrs. Claus's pregnancy but does not flag sexual content.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

entries.title: Turner & Hooch

violence.summary: Crime-comedy violence includes fatal stabbing, gun threats and shootings, a dog being shot and later dying, dog attacks, gun struggles, and a deliberate car crash with blood.

language.summary: Minor profanity, repeated shouting, insults, and gendered put-downs are noted.

romance.summary: Sexual content includes underwear nudity, crude sex talk, kissing, and an implied post-sex scene with suggestive contact.

drinking.summary: A dog is given and steals beer, and the plot involves a drug-smuggling ring.

handoffNotes: The dog shooting and death should get emotional-content prose despite moderate category labels.

entries.title: Flash Gordon

violence.summary: Campy sci-fi violence includes ray-gun and impalement deaths, hand-to-hand fights, non-red blood, bloody whipping, gas threats, and cyborg-like bodies dissolving or losing parts.

language.summary: Only a few mild profanities are noted.

romance.summary: Sexualized material includes Ming's predatory interest in Dale, fondling of an enslaved woman, revealing costumes, talk of lovemaking, and double entendres.

drinking.summary: Characters drink an intoxicating sci-fi beverage, and there is a brief pill-related joke.

handoffNotes: Predatory sexual attention and enslaved-woman fondling may need prose context.

entries.title: The Muppets Take Manhattan

violence.summary: Mild comic peril includes Kermit being hit by a car and developing amnesia, plus Miss Piggy being mugged and then overpowering the thief.

language.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful language concern.

romance.summary: Construction workers catcall Miss Piggy, and Janice has a brief line refusing to remove clothes for art.

drinking.summary: Cigarette smoking is noted.

handoffNotes: Kermit's accident and amnesia may need light prose context for sensitive younger viewers.

entries.title: Harry and the Hendersons

violence.summary: Mostly cartoonish action includes minor fighting, hunters, guns, and shooting scenes without blood.

language.summary: CSM notes several moderate profanities from both a child and adults, including partial stronger words and religious exclamations.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful sex, romance, or nudity concern.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: Hunting and gunfire around a sympathetic creature may need prose context for younger viewers.
